messages:
Arjun: Heads-up — starting a short pairing session to finalize cross-cloud RefKit Terraform templates for cloud partners. Want to align ownership, packaging, and CI. @Micaela @Devin :wave:
Micaela: +1. Question: mono-repo vs per-provider repos? marketplaces (GCP/Azure) want different package artifacts and tests, so repo layout matters for publishing rules.
Devin: my vote is mono-repo with clear subdirs per provider and a /modules common folder. Publish registry releases from tags. Examples under /examples to match marketplace quickstarts.
Sarah: QA note: we need a smoke-test matrix that runs on both x86 and arm64 and on minimal instance sizes. GH actions matrix should cover provider x arch.
Arjun: agreed. Plan: GH Actions with matrix: provider (aws,gcp,azure), arch (amd64,arm64). Add a smoke job that does terraform init/plan and optionally apply behind a secret flag.
Devin: Terraform snippet for provider pinning we should include in the README so partners don't get surprised by provider drift:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 5.0" }
    google = { source = "hashicorp/google" version = "~> 5.0" }
  }
}
```
Micaela: also need a small mapping doc for marketplace manifests (Azure offers ARM templates vs Terraform guidance; GCP wants marketplace schema). I'll draft mapping and share.
Sarah: marketing heads-up: can we loop @Olivia-mktg for synced announce plan? need messaging constraints for marketplace co-marketing.
Arjun: yes — we'll loop Olivia once we have an internal GA checklist. For now, action items: Devin to sketch module layout + release flow, Micaela to draft marketplace mapping + publisher notes, Sarah to add GH Actions smoke-test matrix. Pairing session scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Devin: also adding a note to include a minimal on-prem/private deploy example (KMS hints + HSM note) so SI partners can validate air-gapped installs.
platform-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent — "RefKit Terraform templates pairing" 2025-07-22 10:00 PT.
Micaela: thanks — I'll open an initial branch and PR labeled refkit/terraform-draft and attach the mapping doc.
Arjun: perfect. Small follow-up: include a README template that documents supported regions, recommended instance sizes, cost ballpark, and a troubleshooting checklist. :thumbsup:
Sarah: created GH issue for smoke-test matrix: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/issues/412
Devin: starting layout PR now, ping me if you want to pair on the examples. :coffee:
